reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows that high-entropy diborides were fabricated by SPS and exhibited single-phase structures, with hardness and oxidation resistance often exceeding the average of individual diborides. However, the SPS temperature used in the cited work was 2000 °C, not ≤1700 °C, so the key premise of densification at the lower temperature is unsupported. The other premises are partially supported by the cited data.
premises: High-entropy diborides can be densified at ≤1700 °C via SPS
High-entropy diborides exhibit improved oxidation resistance over individual diborides
High-entropy diborides maintain a single-phase solid solution
High-entropy diborides show enhanced mechanical strength (hardness) compared to individual components
